chunks: Abu al-Fath, the jurist and judge, Muhammad ibn Ali al-Karajaki, who died in the year 449.

key_terms.الْكَرَاجَكِيُّ: the nisbah identifying him as al-Karajaki

ai.seo_question: Who was Abu al-Fath Muhammad ibn Ali al-Karajaki and when did he die?
ai.summary: This text identifies Abu al-Fath al-faqih al-qadi Muhammad ibn Ali al-Karajaki and notes the year of his death. It is a brief biographical notice referring to a scholarly figure.
